outcome: Unfavorable pregnancy outcome (miscarriage, induced abortion, in utero fetal death, stillborn or newborn infant weighing under 500 g or delivered before 24 weeks of gestational age)
Newborn transfer to the paediatric unit or neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 23,291 singleton pregnancies managed at Antoine Béclère Hospital, Clamart, France between April 1, 2007 and December 31, 2015
finding: The risk of maternal-fetal complications increased steadily with maternal age, particularly after 35 years, highlighting the need for closer monitoring in this age group.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section increased with maternal age, reaching more than 40% in women over 40 and more than 60% in women over 45.
